wiki.title: Laura Taliaferro Pearson
wiki.extract: Laura Taliaferro Pearson is an American politician who is member-elect of the Wyoming Senate from the 14th district. In 2024, she defeated the Speaker of the Wyoming House of Representatives, Albert Sommers, in the Republican primary in an upset. Before entering politics, she was a rancher and bus driver.
